name: Pickleball Scorekeeper
tagline: Call the score right, every rally.
description: Keep score for singles and doubles with server tracking, side-out scoring, undo, and spoken score calls.
features: Target score 11, 15 or 21 with optional win-by-two
Serving team, server number and serving side indicator
Undo last rally, new game and reset
Optional sound and spoken score calls
offline: Fully offline after the first launch. Spoken score calls use your device's built-in voice.

name: Match Tracker
description: Log completed matches, see your wins, losses and win percentage, and export your history to CSV.
features: Save completed match results with game scores
offline: Fully offline. Records are saved on this device only and do not sync between devices.

name: Drill Generator
tagline: A fresh practice plan in seconds.
description: Build practice routines by skill level, focus and time, then run them with a built-in timer.
features: Serving, dinking, volleying, footwork or placement focus
Routines built from a curated drill library
offline: Fully offline. The drill library is built in; no AI service or internet connection needed.

name: Tournament Bracket Maker
tagline: Run club tournaments from one device.
description: Generate single-elimination brackets or round-robin schedules, enter scores and print the results.
features: Print or save brackets as PDF
offline: Fully offline on one device. Printing to PDF uses your browser's print dialog.

name: Paddle Finder
tagline: Find the paddle that fits your game.
description: Browse a curated paddle catalog, filter by price, weight, shape and play style, and compare up to three.
features: Filter by price, weight, shape and play style
offline: Catalog, filters and comparison work offline. Retailer links need an internet connection. Prices and availability may change.

name: Rules & Quiz
description: A searchable rules reference with court diagrams, plus a beginner quiz with explanations.
offline: Fully offline. Rules and quiz content are built into the app.
